# reusable transform: copy the 5-shape onto every exact placement whose cells are all zero
from pathlib import Path

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    marker=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==5]
    if not marker: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=min(r for r,c in marker); c0=min(c for r,c in marker)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in marker]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
            if all(0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==0 for rr,cc in cells):
                for rr,cc in cells: out[rr][cc]=5
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform_generic(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x!=0)
    marker=min(counts, key=counts.get)
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c in seeds); c0=min(c for r,c in seeds)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in seeds]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            positions=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
            if all(0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==0 for rr,cc in positions):
                for rr,cc in positions: out[rr][cc]=marker
    return out
